To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the Unr protein binds to a purine-rich motif in the PITSLRE 5′-UTR (untranslated region) and is required for the PITSLRE cell cycle-dependent IRE (internal ribosome-entry site) function; (ii) phosphorylation of eukaryotic initiation factor 2α (eIF-2α) increases PITSLRE IRE activity, and (iii) eIF-2 kinase is a potential candidate to mediate this

the PITSLER kinase IRES is regulated by the cell cycle, and this regulation is achieved by the combined effects of the cell cycle-dependent increase in Unr protein levels and phosphorylation of eI2alpha, which is a general mechanism for the control of cell cycle-dependent IREs.
the cell-cycle-dependent IRES activity of the PITSLR protein kinase depends on Unr protein binding and eIF-2 alpha phosphorylation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of cis- and/or trans-acting factors that regulate PITSLRE IRE activity and the mechanism by which these factors act to modulate IRES activity during the cell cycle.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the PITSLIRE IRES is regulated by the interaction with the Unr RNA-binding protein and by eIF-2 alpha phosphorylation.
the PITSLER IRES is regulated by the Unr protein and by the phosphorylation of eIf2alpha, which are both more abundant at the G2-M phase of the cell cycle.
the PITSLERe IRES is regulated by the Unr protein and by phosphorylated eIF-2, two proteins that are more abundant at G2/M.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Unr and phosphorylated eIF-2 are involved in the regulation of PITSLRE IREs, and this regulation is cell-cycle dependent.
the PITSLERE IRES is a novel cell cycle-regulated internal initiation element that interacts with the cell cycle-regulated Unr protein and is modulated by eIF-2 alpha phosphorylation.
the cell-cycle-regulated PITSLRE IES activity is mediated by the Unr protein in a manner dependent on the phosphorylation of eIIF-2alpha.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cell cycle-dependent internal initiation of translation of the p58(PITLSRRE) protein kinase requires the presence of the Unr protein and the phosphorylation of eIf2alpha.
the PITSLER IRES is regulated at the G2-M stage of the cell-cycle by the interaction between Unr protein and the IRES, and by the phosphorylation status of translation initiation factor eIf-2α.
the cell-cycle-regulated PITSLRE Ires activity is mediated by the Unr protein and the phosphorylation status of eIF- 2alpha.
